collector: AI-assisted exact official HTML source observation

records.academicNote: STEM bachelor/equivalent, SOUND MATHEMATICS and computer-programming skills. The general welcome wording does not remove the STEM degree or technical preparation. No numeric GPA or fixed work years are established. MOE accreditation is not automatic personal subsidy eligibility; specialty tracks and optional embedded certifications are not separate degrees.
records.documentNote: THREE recommenders, 1,000-word statement, CV, identity and degree/transcript evidence. Recommendations are due ONE WEEK AFTER APPLICATION. GRE is RECOMMENDED but NOT REQUIRED. Applicable English scores are due by the application deadline; originals/certified English translations and expected-award evidence follow the exact checklist. Do not copy the two-referee, 500-word MTD checklist.

records.academicNote: Related bachelor, written/spoken MANDARIN and education/teaching/EdTech interest and preparation. Unrelated disciplines may be considered case by case with a resumé or portfolio; related employment is considered without a fixed work-year minimum. The programme is bilingual and requires first-term China study, not an English-only Singapore programme.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments. Own checklist requires Mandarin; no numeric English threshold is copied from a sibling.

records.academicNote: Programme introduction welcomes engineering, physics, chemistry or mathematics with sound maths/programming. Detailed alternatives are Computer Science or any Engineering bachelor OR related discipline PLUS TWO YEARS ICT experience. Do not impose two years on every CS/Engineering graduate or automatically accept all science degrees. The committee assesses equivalence; interview includes an oral coding assessment. No numeric GPA established.
records.documentNote: THREE recommenders, 1,000-word statement, CV, identity and degree/transcript evidence. Recommendations are due ONE WEEK AFTER APPLICATION. GRE is RECOMMENDED but NOT REQUIRED. Applicable English scores are due by the application deadline; originals/certified English translations and expected-award evidence follow the exact checklist. Do not copy the two-referee, 500-word MTD checklist.

records.academicNote: Related bachelor; unrelated degree candidates may be considered individually using resumé/portfolio evidence. Relevant job experience is considered without mandatory numeric years. This Advanced IC programme is distinct from the IC Design/Failure Analysis programme and does not inherit its compulsory Suzhou internship.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments.

records.academicNote: Related bachelor; finance/economics/business/management and quantitative/technical backgrounds are named, with other interdisciplinary paths considered individually. Written/spoken MANDARIN is required. Relevant job experience is considered without fixed years. First-term China study and bilingual delivery remain explicit.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments. Own checklist requires Mandarin; no numeric English threshold is copied from a sibling.

records.academicNote: Bachelor in Architecture, Engineering, Construction or a built-environment-related field. Unrelated-degree cases may be considered individually. Relevant capstone projects/work are considered; a portfolio of relevant projects is REQUESTED for applicants, not solely an optional alternative for unrelated majors. No numeric GPA or mandatory work years established.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments. A portfolio of relevant capstone projects is REQUESTED separately, including for related-degree candidates.

records.academicNote: Computer Science bachelor OR relevant discipline with a SUBSTANTIAL COMPUTING ELEMENT. Unrelated-degree cases may be considered individually with resumé/portfolio. Generic AI interest or a degree title alone does not prove computing preparation. Work is considered without fixed years; no numeric GPA established.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments.

records.academicNote: Technology bachelor including Engineering/Computing/Applied Sciences OR another related discipline PLUS TWO YEARS ICT industry experience. Proficiency in Java, C/C++, Python or another modern programming language is required. The two-year condition is an ALTERNATIVE pathway, not universal employment for every graduate. Unrelated-degree cases need individual review; no numeric GPA established.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments.

records.academicNote: Related bachelor including Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science or Applied Sciences. Basic calculus, linear algebra, probability and statistics are EXPECTED; Python/R familiarity is BENEFICIAL, not a separate mandatory programming-language gate. Unrelated-degree cases may be individually considered with evidence. No numeric GPA or mandatory work years established.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, AT LEAST 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments.

records.academicNote: Related bachelor including Engineering or Biomedical Science; unrelated-degree cases may be individually considered with resumé/portfolio. Relevant work is considered without fixed years. Hospital immersion is described as LOCAL, not the compulsory China internship of the different IC programme; it does not confer healthcare professional registration.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments.

records.academicNote: BA, BSc or related bachelor; unrelated-degree cases may be considered individually with resumé/portfolio. Relevant employment is considered, without fixed years or a numeric GPA. The degree is Human-Centred Design, distinct from the existing Human-Centred AI for Venture Innovation record.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments.

records.academicNote: Related bachelor; unrelated-degree cases may be individually considered with resumé/portfolio. Work is considered without fixed years. A TWO-MONTH SUZHOU INTERNSHIP is REQUIRED FOR GRADUATION. The schedule heading labels it 12 credit points while its description calls it not credit-bearing; this inconsistency is retained and is not an undergraduate entry-credit prerequisite.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments.

records.academicNote: Closely related bachelor including Electronics/Optoelectronics/Materials Engineering, Physics or Materials Science. Electromagnetics/wave optics, linear algebra/calculus, basic Python/MATLAB and relevant lab experience are ADVANTAGEOUS, NOT NECESSARY. Unrelated-degree cases may be individually considered. Do not convert preferences into hard rejection or borrow the Data Science prior-maths wording.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments.

records.academicNote: Related bachelor including Engineering, Computing, Physics, Applied Science or Mathematics. Unrelated-degree cases may be individually considered. Relevant work is considered without fixed years. A PORTFOLIO showcasing relevant capstone projects is REQUESTED for applicants; no numeric GPA or universal employment minimum established.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments. A portfolio of relevant capstone projects is REQUESTED separately, including for related-degree candidates.

records.academicNote: Bachelor/equivalent plus demonstrated interest in urban issues, policy, design or technology. Diverse Engineering/Design/Architecture/Social Science/Public Policy/Business backgrounds are welcome; unrelated-degree cases assessed individually. Projects/work may support the case without fixed years. This design-innovation degree is distinct from Urban Science, Policy and Planning.
records.documentNote: Identity, bachelor/transcript, applicable English evidence, TWO referees, approximately 500-word statement and CV. Documents accompany the application; non-English documents need official/certified English translations. The platform neither collects nor submits these private materials. Resumé/portfolio alternatives and interviews remain individual assessments.

records.academicNote: Bachelor or above; a wide range of academic/professional backgrounds and interest in digital technology, urban planning and policy are welcomed. No numeric undergraduate GPA or fixed employment years are established. A research practicum or possible individually supervised research project does not turn this coursework MSc into a research-admission degree.
records.documentNote: TWO referees with recommendations ONE WEEK AFTER APPLICATION; 1,000-word Statement of Objectives; degree/transcript, identity, applicable English and relevant portfolio/awards/publications evidence. GRE is OPTIONAL. English results may arrive up to TWO WEEKS AFTER THE APPLICATION DEADLINE; this is a supporting-document allowance, not an application extension. Non-English documents require official English translations.

boundaries.identity: Sixteen existing IDs, no extra degree, theme or route. Legacy DAI-E and Education titles now use exact official pages. DAI-E/MTD-AI and MSSD/MTD-Cybersecurity remain separate degrees.
boundaries.scope: Education/Finance require first-term China study; IC Failure Analysis requires Suzhou internship. Three exact delivery exclusions, not applicant academic failures. MSSD international attachment is an opportunity, not universal required China attendance.
boundaries.fees: Ten active FT mode/category contexts use exact 2027/28 GST-inclusive 49,050/54,500 quotes. Three PT contexts retain NULL whole-course tuition and 24,525/27,250 annual wording because fees can change. No inferred scholarship/subsidy, automatic GST addition or double-counted credited acceptance payment. Scope-excluded IC fees of 55,917/62,130 differ.
boundaries.language: DAI-E 6.5/90 differs from MTD 6.0/85. MSSD has no established numeric cutoff; Mandarin is explicit for Education/Finance. Three AND/OR phrasings remain unresolved. MUSPP unlabelled TOEFL triplet and new scale remain manual. Application-based validity is not expiry from today.
boundaries.admission: Cybersecurity/MSSD two-year ICT conditions are alternatives, not universal employment. IPST foundational knowledge is advantageous, not necessary. Data Science maths is expected and Python/R beneficial. Architecture/Robotics request project portfolios; their approximately 500-word statements differ from Data Science's minimum of 500. DAI-E/MSSD request three referees and 1,000 words; MUSPP two referees and 1,000 words.
boundaries.dates: MTD's deadline of 31 May 2027 has no exact opening day or cutoff time. MSSD retains closed 2026 dates; DAI-E's next window is unknown. MUSPP opens on 9 Nov 2026, not yet open on 3 Nov; the inconsistent 24 Jan 2026 rolling line is not silently corrected or treated as another opening.

preservation: Prior 312 parent objects, 39 route snapshots, 205 contexts, catalogue/workbook/directory/history and main/W4/W5/StudyWeek/W6/W7 refs preserved. Scope decisions appended, not rewritten.
